Row.SQL: WITH check_mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::numeric AS "budget", $2::text AS "description", $3::uuid AS "id", $4::text AS "name") AS data WHERE true), mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "public"."departments" ("budget", "description", "id", "name") SELECT check_mutation_result."budget", check_mutation_result."description", check_mutation_result."id", check_mutation_result."name" FROM check_mutation_result RETURNING *) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_physical")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT "id"::text AS "id", "name"::text AS "name", "description"::text AS "description", "budget"::text AS "budget", "has_high_budget"::text AS "has_high_budget", "created_at"::text AS "created_at", "updated_at"::text AS "updated_at" FROM mutation_result) AS "_physical"

Batch.SQL: WITH check_mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::text AS "role", $2::uuid AS "user_id", $3::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "department_id" UNION ALL SELECT $4::text AS "role", $5::uuid AS "user_id", $6::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "department_id") AS data WHERE true), mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "public"."user_departments" ("role", "user_id", "department_id") SELECT check_mutation_result."role", check_mutation_result."user_id", check_mutation_result."department_id" FROM check_mutation_result RETURNING *) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_physical")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT "user_id"::text AS "user_id", "department_id"::text AS "department_id", "role"::text AS "role", "joined_at"::text AS "joined_at", "is_active"::text AS "is_active" FROM mutation_result) AS "_physical"

Insert.FinalSQL: WITH mutation_result AS (SELECT (value ->> 'id')::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "id", (value ->> 'name')::text::pg_catalog.text AS "name", (value ->> 'description')::text::pg_catalog.text AS "description", (value ->> 'budget')::text::pg_catalog."numeric" AS "budget", (value ->> 'has_high_budget')::text::pg_catalog.bool AS "has_high_budget", (value ->> 'created_at')::text::pg_catalog.timestamptz AS "created_at", (value ->> 'updated_at')::text::pg_catalog.timestamptz AS "updated_at" FROM json_array_elements($1::json) AS "_rows"(value)) SELECT row_to_json((SELECT "_e" FROM (SELECT mutation_result."id" AS "id") AS "_e")) FROM mutation_result
